entries: This must be what @ was talking about; the seed planted in us.
这一定就是 @ 所说的；种进我们体内的那颗种子。
I think I've seen enough of the unseen for today.
今天看不见的东西，我看得够多了。
Excuse me??? No... no no no.
You can have my share. I plan to see this through.
我那份归你。我打算把这件事做到底。
Might need help from Scaphin without curse. I go!
也许需要没中诅咒的斯卡芬，来帮忙。我去！
I believe we are seeing the curse for the first time. This thing... it is beyond my understanding. I must research...
我相信，这是我们第一次真正见到这诅咒的模样。这东西……超出了我的理解。我必须去研究……
My journey will continue. Stay if you wish, but I will see this through no matter what.
我的旅程会继续。你想留就留下，但无论如何，我都要把这件事做到底。
We saw these creatures in the Lacunaria. They must be the harvesters.
我们在拉库纳里亚见过这些生物。他们一定就是收割者。
We will seek nonetheless. And we will prevail.
即便如此，我们仍要去寻找。而且我们必将胜利。
Where would we find his grave, if he even has one?
我们去哪里找他的坟墓，如果他真有坟墓的话？
Whatever the course of action, I believe that you and your companions are the only ones who can succeed.
无论采取何种行动，我相信，只有你和你的同伴们能够成功。
Defeated. It is not the same. I am sorry. I did not know either, before I regained my memories.
是被打败。那不一样。我很抱歉。在我取回记忆之前，我也不知道。
我们已经准备好面对一切。
We will do it. We will seek the Dark Lord.
我们会去做的。我们会去寻找黑暗领主。
Make that @'s share. I doubt he'll need it.
那份就留给 @ 吧。我猜他也用不着。
Companionship rather than servitude. I will not end this relationship.
是陪伴，而非奴役。我不会结束这份关系。
You must be joking. He was destroyed!
你一定是在开玩笑。他已经被毁灭了！
One of the branches looks different.
其中一根枝条看起来不一样。
Had you not helped me to remember I would not have recognized that the guardian was among us.
若不是你们帮我找回记忆，我不会认出守护者就在我们中间。
He wishes to share a vision with you.
他想与你们分享一场幻象。
You must make a choice @. By all rights you have accomplished what you set out to do.
你必须做出选择，@。按理说，你已经完成了当初要做的事。
You can leave. Find your daughter. Live the life you want.
你可以离开。去找你的女儿。去过你想要的生活。
Regrettably, I do not know. Maybe he had help.
很遗憾，我不知道。也许有人帮了他。
That is why you must seek him out. Find out how to stop this curse.
正因如此，你必须去寻找他。弄清怎样终结这诅咒。
It was the Codex that was used to bind him, and it may prevent him from clouding your judgement.
当初用来束缚他的正是典籍，它也许能阻止他蒙蔽你们的判断。
Keep it close, and may your travels be protected by the light.
把它带在身边，愿你的旅途受光明庇佑。
I was kind of looking forward to taking a rest.
我还挺期待能歇一歇的。
Such surprises are to be expected when dealing in the arcane world.
与奥术世界打交道，这种意外本就在意料之中。
不是他的坟墓。是他的囚牢。
Did it work? Is the curse lifted?
成功了吗？诅咒解除了吗？
Then let us be fools. I will not give up. Besides, I never found my lost sheep, remember?
那就让我们当傻瓜吧。我不会放弃。再说，我那只走丢的羊还没找回来呢，记得吗？
Yes. Will do all to help. Will give all.
会。会倾尽全力相助。会付出一切。
I believe so, but this door suggests more to the story.
我想是的，但这扇门说明事情还有下文。
The Codex is not just a book, as I have explained. This door would not have opened for just anyone.
典籍，并非只是一本书，正如我所解释过的。这扇门不会为随便什么人就打开。
I feel that I would be leaving behind a great danger. Could I enjoy a life with her while such danger lurks?
我觉得自己会抛下一个巨大的危险。这样的危险潜伏着，我怎能安心与她过活？
Glad to be Scaphin, not human.
庆幸是斯卡芬，不是人类。
I see no other way, but know this: he is untrustworthy and dangerous, even while bound.
我看不到别的办法，但你要知道这一点：即便被束缚着，他也不可信、且危险。
Do not fully trust his words. There may be truth, but he will always twist it.
不要完全相信他的话。也许其中有真话，但他总会加以扭曲。
It is beautiful. And likely dangerous.
它很美。而且多半很危险。
I can't resist an adventure. I'm in.
我抵挡不住冒险。算我一个。
*sigh* Stop making me look bad. I'm in.
*叹气* 别再让我显得不够义气了。算我一个。
Do we even know that it can be destroyed?
我们真的知道它能够被毁灭吗？
We have peered into other worlds before. Let us see this vision then.
我们从前也窥探过别的世界。那就让我们看看这场幻象吧。
This has been happening all around us? For how long?
这种事一直发生在我们周围？持续多久了？
Don't be jealous boy. No one can replace you.
别吃醋，伙计。没人能取代你。
I saw this cat before I fell into the caves. This explains a lot.
掉进洞穴，那是很久以前，在那之前我就见过这只猫。这一下能解释很多事。
黑暗领主还活着。好极了。
I felt a power from the Codex sweep across me.
我感到一股来自典籍的力量扫过我全身。
You are saying that we are meant to go down there?
你是说，我们注定要下到那里去？
Are you saying that we all have this thing growing out of us? I think I'm going to be sick.
你是说，我们体内都长着这东西？我想我要吐了。
And how did he level the curse from such a prison? Was he not fully bound?
可他从这样的囚牢里，是怎么降下诅咒的？他并没有被完全束缚住吗？
And what will happen when we destoy this thing?
那等我们毁掉这东西，会发生什么？
I'd still be in a crypt if it weren't for you. You can count on me.
要不是你，我还躺在墓室里。你可以信赖我。
He only appears as a cat, but is something more than that.
他只是以猫的形态现身，但远不止是一只猫。
He wishes to share a vision with you @, as he did when you first met him.
他想与你分享一场幻象，@，就像你们初次相见时那样。
This room was made for revealing hidden things. It is a place to glimpse into the unseen.
这间厅堂是为揭示隐秘而造的。在这里可以窥见不可见之物。
Prepare yourself. I do not know what you will see, and it may be difficult to accept.
做好准备。我不知道你会看见什么，也许难以接受。
Place the Codex into the slot.
So... the place with all the dark energy still corrupting things above? Great!
所以……就是那个满是黑暗能量、还在污染上方万物的地方？好极了！
Then it is decided. One chapter closes, and another begins.
那就这么定了。一章落幕，另一章开启。
The pursuit of knowledge is a righteous endeavor, but some things will remain a mystery no matter how hard you seek.
追求知识是正当的事业，但有些事物，无论你如何求索，终究是谜。
This sounds like a fool's errand.
这听着像是傻子才干的差事。
So be it. You will find him in a dungeon far below this place, where he was bound for 1000 years.
那就这样吧。你会在这地方地底深处的地牢里找到他，他在那里被囚禁了一千年。
We will face it together friend. No matter what comes.
我们一起面对，朋友。无论将要发生什么。
I have not yet made sense of this vision. Something went wrong, for certain.
我还没能弄清这场幻象的含义。可以确定的是，有哪里出了差错。
We must hurry and use the Codex.
我们必须赶快使用典籍。
I am not sure that he even can be killed.
我甚至不确定他能否被杀死。
I will come, on one condition... extra treasure. A double portion!
我会来，但有一个条件……额外宝藏。要双份！
He has been waiting to show you this for some time.
他想给你看这个，已经等了很久。
but.. I do not know what we are seeing.
但是……我不知道我们看到的是什么。
Then it begins. The next stage in our journey. We still do not know the nature of the fog.
那就开始吧。我们旅程的下一段。迷雾的本质，我们仍未弄清。
And, our knowledge of the Codex is limited. But we will find answers!
而且，我们对典籍的了解有限。但我们终会找到答案！
Coorou! Maybe, having Scaphin without curse will help. Can hope.
咕罗！也许有个没中诅咒的斯卡芬，能帮上忙。可以抱希望。
You willl need each other more than ever, for you must seek... the Dark Lord.
你们会比以往任何时候都更需要彼此，因为你们必须去寻找……黑暗领主。
I know you are, daughter. Your steadfastness has brought you this far.
我知道你会，女儿。正是你的坚韧让你走到了今天。
